title: Parking outside Perth and Peel: no regional table in Chapter 4 Part 1
text: Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3a. [No regional parking table is printed in Chapter 4 Part 1; Table 2.3a Locations A and B carry no Perth and Peel limit.]

replaces.note: current parking tables apply state-wide; Chapters 2 and 3 add Table 2.3b for outside Perth and Peel, Chapter 4 Part 1 does not

verified.note: Gap record: no regional parking table is printed on p19-20; Table 2.3a carries no Perth and Peel limit.

notes: new: records a gap, not a provision. ToC p7 says a separate regional table is provided and that Locations A and B do not apply outside Perth and Peel; Chapter 4 Part 1 has no such table (register C4P1-048). Table 2.3a rules (C2.3.1, C2.3.3, C2.3.5, C2.3.7) are region all and still run; whether DPLH intends them to apply regionally, or a regional table is missing, needs confirmation. No value invented.
